items.title: Oracle Stocks Sink 5.13% to 52-Week Low as Default Swaps Hit Record
items.summary: Five-year protection on Oracle debt reached 360 basis points as investors question how a $664 billion backlog gets funded.

items.title: Oracle Stock Dipped Under $100 as Banks Try to Unload Its Data-Center Loans
items.summary: Oracle's backlog is huge and the demand is real, yet lenders are quietly accepting steep discounts on the debt behind its data centers. What does the bond market see that the analysts' bullish targets don't?

items.title: Cerebras Expands AI Inference Reach: Can It Challenge NVDA & AMD?
items.summary: CBRS is ramping up its AI inference capabilities with hyperscaler partnerships, wafer-scale innovations, and expanding capacity to challenge NVIDIA and Advanced Micro Devices.

items.title: Jim Cramer Says Micron Stock Is “Comically Cheap” at About 3 Times Earnings
items.summary: Micron just posted the most profitable year in its history, yet the stock has shed a third of its value in a month. Memory's long record of boom and bust may explain why investors refuse to pay up.

items.title: Oracle Is Down 47% in 2026. Is There Really a “Reasonable Chance Oracle Goes Bankrupt”?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOracle stock is down 47% in 2026 and hit a fresh 52-week low as the cost of insuring its debt against default reached a record. The same AI credit fears have hit CoreWeave, whose debt insurance also hit a record, and Nvidia, which sells both companies their chips.

items.title: How Will Oracle's Heavy AI Spending Shape the Stock's Cash Flow Trend?
items.summary: ORCL's aggressive AI infrastructure spending is weighing on free cash flow, but rising cloud demand and easing capital expenditures could drive a turnaround.

items.title: Oracle Corporation (ORCL) Is a Trending Stock: Facts to Know Before Betting on It
items.summary: Oracle (ORCL) has received quite a bit of attention from Zacks.com users lately. Therefore, it is wise to be aware of the facts that can impact the stock's prospects.

items.title: Here’s Why $35 Is The Price to Buy Intel, and No Higher
items.summary: Intel's data center business is booming, Nvidia is buying in, and analysts see big upside. Yet the stock has plunged in a month, and its foundry still has to prove itself. What would make the entry point finally worth the risk?
